meta.title: Further education and skills: participation and achievements by learner home LA, provision type, level and age
meta.geography: LA, region, England; Bedfordshire 3-UA total for counts
meta.quality: Accredited official statistics from the ILR (census of government-funded FE learners, mainly aged 19+ plus apprentices of all ages). Latest year is in-year (Aug-Apr) and provisional.
meta.limitations: Learner HOME location, not provider location. Figures rounded to nearest 10; 'low' (<5) and 'c' cells suppressed (null, suppressed=true). 'Further education and skills' total includes apprenticeships; 'Education and training' and 'Community learning' / 'Tailored learning' are sub-types. Funding-stream renames: Adult Education Budget became the Adult Skills Fund from 2024/25 and Community Learning was reclassified as 'Tailored learning' - provision-type labels change across years so check breakdown strings. Skills Bootcamps are NOT in these tables (separate publication, no home-LA split). 16-18 classroom learners in colleges/sixth forms are largely outside this publication (see 16-19 performance). SSA x level enrolments by LA only for the latest in-year period; rates per 100,000 use ONS mid-year population. Participation counts learners once per provision type; totals across types are not additive.
